description: NVIDIA's API Catalog provides free trial endpoints hosted on DGX Cloud for NVIDIA and third-party NIM models; production deployments use self-hosted NIM or dedicated partner endpoints.

sources.notes: Official hosted NIM model API references document the shared integrate.api.nvidia.com Chat Completions endpoint and model-specific schemas.
Official self-hosted NIM reference documents Chat Completions, Completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages, streaming, tools, usage, management endpoints, and the absence of Batch support.
NVIDIA's unauthenticated OpenAI-compatible model registry returned 102 exact hosted model IDs spanning NVIDIA and third-party publishers.
Official quickstart states that trial NIM endpoints are hosted by NVIDIA on DGX Cloud and authenticated with a free NVIDIA Developer API key.

Trial terms permit collection of session and execution logs and User Content and Generated Content to operate and improve NVIDIA products and services, including AI models; no numeric retention period is published.

NVIDIA describes hosted NIM endpoints as free access for prototyping through Developer Program membership; the hosted catalog publishes no per-token price schedule and directs production users to self-hosted NIM or partners.

verification.notes: Hosted registry, transport, free trial positioning, lifecycle boundary, and data-use terms verified against first-party NVIDIA sources; numeric rate limits and hosted per-token prices are not publicly specified.
